label: UM_NOTICE
subject: Reminder: Semester 1 2026/2027 tuition fee payment deadline
body_text:
Dear students,

This is a reminder that tuition fees for Semester 1 2026/2027 must be paid by 21 November 2026. Students with outstanding fees will be barred from sitting the final examination.

Payment can be made via the MAYA portal.

Bursary Office, Universiti Malaya

label: UM_NOTICE
subject: Final Examination Timetable Semester 1 Session 2026/2027
body_text: The final examination timetable for Semester 1 is now available on MAYA. Please check your examination venue and seat number. Any clash must be reported to your faculty before 15 November 2026.

label: UM_NOTICE
subject: Scheduled maintenance: Siswamail and MAYA unavailable on Sunday
body_text: Please be informed that Siswamail and MAYA will be unavailable on Sunday 16 November 2026 from 1:00 am to 6:00 am for scheduled maintenance. We apologise for any inconvenience.

label: HACKATHON
subject: UM Hackathon 2026: Build for Campus, RM10,000 in prizes
body_text: Calling all coders, designers and dreamers! UM Hackathon 2026 is a 36-hour hackathon happening on 5-6 December at FSKTM. Teams of 3-5. Register by 28 November: https://forms.gle/umhack2026

label: HACKATHON
subject: Invitation: National Case Study Competition 2026
body_text: FBE invites undergraduate teams to compete in the National Case Study Competition. Analyse a real business case and pitch to industry judges. Submission of team details closes on 25 November 2026.

label: HACKATHON
subject: Shopee Code League is back: register now
body_text: Shopee Code League is a 2-month online coding competition open to all university students in the region. Compete in data analytics and algorithm rounds. Registration closes 30 November.

label: RESEARCH
subject: Vacancy: Graduate Research Assistant (Machine Learning)
sender_name: Dr. Lim, Dept. of Artificial Intelligence
body_text: Our lab is looking for a part-time research assistant to work on a funded project on Malay language models. Final year students with Python experience are welcome. Send your CV by 20 November 2026.

label: RESEARCH
subject: Call for applications: Undergraduate Research Programme 2027
sender_name: Institute of Research Management and Services
body_text: The Undergraduate Research Programme gives Year 2 and Year 3 students a chance to do a supervised research project with a stipend of RM500 per month. Applications close 12 December 2026.

label: RESEARCH
subject: Call for papers: Student Symposium on Sustainable Engineering
body_text: Undergraduate and postgraduate students are invited to submit extended abstracts on sustainable engineering research. Accepted papers will be presented at the symposium in January. Abstract deadline: 1 December 2026.

label: EVENT
subject: Public lecture: The Future of AI in Southeast Asia
sender_name: Faculty of Computer Science and IT
body_text: You are invited to a public lecture by a visiting professor on 20 November 2026, 3:00 pm at Dewan Kuliah Utama, FSKTM. Free admission, light refreshments provided.

label: EVENT
subject: Mental Health Awareness Week: workshops and talks
body_text: Join us for Mental Health Awareness Week from 18 to 22 November. Daily workshops on stress management, mindfulness sessions and a talk by counsellors. Sign up for workshops by 17 November.

label: EVENT
subject: Deepavali Cultural Night 2026
body_text: Celebrate the festival of lights with performances, food and music at Dewan Tunku Canselor on 8 November, 7 pm. Open to all UM students and staff.

label: SCHOLARSHIP_CAREER
subject: Yayasan Khazanah Scholarship 2027 applications open
body_text: Applications for the Yayasan Khazanah undergraduate scholarship are now open. Malaysian students with CGPA 3.5 and above may apply online before 30 November 2026.

label: SCHOLARSHIP_CAREER
subject: Internship opportunities: Petronas Summer Internship 2027
body_text: Petronas is offering 10-week internships for engineering, IT and business students. Apply through the Petronas careers portal by 5 December 2026.

label: SCHOLARSHIP_CAREER
subject: UM Career Fair 2026: 80 employers, meet them on campus
body_text: Bring your CV! The UM Career Fair 2026 takes place on 26-27 November at Dewan Tunku Canselor with over 80 employers hiring graduates and interns.

label: CLUB
subject: Robotics Club: Open Recruitment Session 2026/2027
body_text: We are recruiting new members and committee for the new session! No experience needed. Fill in the form by 15 November: https://forms.gle/umrobotics

label: CLUB
subject: Annual General Meeting of the Computer Science Society
body_text: All members are invited to the society's AGM on 14 November at 8 pm in Bilik Seminar 1. We will elect the new committee and present the annual report.

label: CLUB
subject: Photography Club monthly newsletter: November
body_text: Hello members! This month's photo walk is in Kuala Lumpur old town. Check out last month's winning photos and our new equipment loan schedule.

label: NOT_FOR_ME
subject: 50% off all laptops this 11.11!
body_text: Mega 11.11 sale! Get up to 50% off laptops, phones and accessories. Use code STUDENT11 at checkout. Offer ends midnight.

label: NOT_FOR_ME
subject: Your account will be suspended: verify now
body_text: Your mailbox has exceeded its quota and will be suspended in 24 hours. Click here to verify your password immediately.

label: NOT_FOR_ME
subject: Survey on coffee drinking habits (marketing research)
body_text: Tell us about your coffee habits and stand a chance to win a RM20 voucher. The survey takes 15 minutes.
